name: Rukonzo
translator_note: A working Lhukonzo translation covering the whole interface. Lhukonzo is a Bantu language of the Rwenzori (JD40, the Konzo-Nande group) and the grammar here follows it, with plain concrete vocabulary; long marketing sentences are carried across as short factual ones rather than rendered word for word. Written by UG, not by a first-language speaker: a Lukonzo speaker's correction outranks anything here, and the correction button is on every screen.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG akakania emibughe y'e Uganda, ey'ekitsweka, n'ey'abagheni. Sombolha eyaghu; ebindi byosi bikakwama.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: Enzira nguma eyikakanganaya emihendo y'ebyuma byosi eby'e Uganda haghuma, eyikagabania olughendo lhw'ekyanya kikulhu neryo Prado yikahwa ekitsweka kighuma, eyikapanga emmotoka omwa kanya wutholere erihika, n'eyikahangira ekitsweka kya paka embere sy'esyapermiti sihwe. Erilihira ngoku Kampala yikalihira: esyasente sy'oko simu.
strings.doorRiderSub: Hangira ekitsweka, lingirira emihendo yosi, tegheka wikendi.
strings.doorDriverSub: Bugha ahandi wangatholera. Emirimu eyiwithe esyasente yikasa yiti.
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Ekyerekaniro v1 · buli muhendo ni kilengesyo ekilhua omo kipimo ekikanganire · esyasente sikaghenda omo kyerekaniro busa · sihali kindu ekyahebirwe olhukuratho
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Emihendo yosi eyiri okwibalha, oko kyerekaniro kighuma, eyihirwe omo ndondeko.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Ekyerisombolha nabi kikahwa <small>obulhengekania bw'emihendo oko lughendo olhu</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atlas · enzira syosi, oko mesa nguma <small>endeke, ebasi, amaghetse, egari, esyamotoka sya Signature, n'ahakusighalha, n'ekwenene oko buli nguma</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Hangira oko UG ahali enzira, Hamagha embere ahathali, Isirikire okw'iminya, Yikasa oko byakine bikakolwa. Emihendo ni bilengesyo kandi bikabugha bityo.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Esitegi y'oko simu · ebitsweka bikasusuma, neryo emmotoka yikasa
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Ngoku esitegi y'ematatu, emmotoka yikaghenda yikahulhuka kutse oko buthuku obwahirawe. Aliwe hano, wukalihira ighuli okwiyo wenyu, omuhendo w'ekitsweka akakehera abanywani bakingira, kandi omughendesya oyukayitwalha abirimabugha athi atholere oko nzira eyo.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Ahasyasitegi sikasusuma bunguhe <small>Pulse · ebitsweka ebilihiribwe okwihambana n'abaghendesya, oko buli muyi</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Esyabasi oko nzira eno <small>enzira eyindi, hakuhi n'esitegi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buli nzira nayo yiwithe esyabasi. Lingirira obuthuku bw'erighenda oko bakolhi bosi, minya epaka eyiwukalhua, kandi hangira oko UG ahali omukolhi akaligha erihangira oko simu. Ahathali, thukabugha thuthi, neryo thukakuha enamba y'erihamagha, sithukakuha akapande akathakolha.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buli mmotoka eyipangirwe n'omughendesya na buli lughendo olhugabanirwe lhuwithe enzira y'erisuba. Enzira y'erighenda yikahangirwa, ebitsweka by'erisuba bikatsuka erighulhibwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Hira olughendo lhwaghu, kutse lengesya omuhendo w'ekitsweka <small>Pool · abanywani baghu, omuhendo w'okwenene w'enzira ogugabanirwe oko bitsweka</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Ha ekitsweka, kutse lingirira ekitsweka kikatholere erihwa kingahi
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Esyanzira esyahirawe sikasighalha omo kyuma kikyu kyonyene erihika wukingira. Pool yikakwama enzira nguma: esyakawunti esyaminyikalire n'esimu, akanya k'erikania, n'erilingirirania okwabiri, haghuma n'ebitsweka by'abanywani neryo wughende n'abandu abawuminyire.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Wughendesye wenyu oko kiro, kutse n'omughendesya oko saha, kutse esyamotoka sya Signature ahakuhika hakwamire. Omuhendo ni w'omundu nguma wukagabania.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Tuma ekindu. Kya buli bunene, oko buli lhuhandi.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Abatumi bosi ab'omo muyi oko kyerekaniro kighuma, bahirwe omo ndondeko. Okwa mbali, ekindu kikaghenda omo mmotoka y'esitegi oko kitsweka ky'ekitsweka kighuma, kandi omo buthuku bw'erisarulha, minibasi, pikapu kutse elori n'omughendesya.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Emihendo y'abatumi ni bilengesyo bya UG ebilhua omo kipimo ekikanganire; 8 to 8 e Jinja yikabughwa erilhua omo nyaruta y'omuhangiki kandi omuhendo wayo ni kilengesyo. Ekindu oko Sitegi ni muhendo wa UG: ekitsweka ky'ekitsweka kighuma oko sitegi eyo, kilihirwe omughendesya haghuma n'ebitsweka.
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wikendi yosi y'omo paka, omo namba nguma.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Erikingira omo paka, esyapermiti, emihendo y'emmotoka, ahakusighalha, esente y'ebyalya n'enzira eyo, byosi bilhengesibwe oko banya East Africa, abagheni abikere hano n'abagheni. Abanya East Africa bakalihira emihendo y'e East Africa.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Hambania ekiro kyosi <small>Hustle Mode · buli lhughendo lhulhengesirwe oko nzira eyilhere; ewalethi n'endegheka bikiri by'erilengesya</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: UG Walethi · esente sy'erilengesya, si sy'okwenene
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Bugha ahandi wangatholera, lhuguma. Ligha esyamotoka esyusuire.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Siwalindirira oko sitegi, siwalhaghira, siwahighania. Ekyuwutholere erilebya ni Mapu y'Obutholere: ahawukalhua, olhuhandi, esyanzira, esyasaha, n'ebyuthalyanza. Emirimu yikasa yiwithe esyasente omukatikati.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Ahabakayithagha emmotoka omo lubulhe olhu <small>Foresight · erisarulha, ebihango n'ebyakakolwa, olhubulhe embere, oko buli mmotoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Laghana wuthi wukendisya bya yo neryo omwanya wikale ndeke oko bosi. Obuminyi bukakanganibwa oko buli kimenyekesyo; ebiro by'omwaka ni bilhaghiro erihika erisarulha ery'erimbere ribibigheresye.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Obuminyi bukakanganibwa oko buli kimenyekesyo; ebiro by'omwaka ni bilhaghiro erihika hasyabya esyanzira esyusuire eryo erigheresya.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Esaiti ni yo app. Yihire, kutse usome ekhodi.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Ekihimbo kighuma oko intaneti n'oko simu: ekawunti nguma, esyasitegi nguma, n'Ekimenyekesyo kighuma oko kyerekaniro. Siwendighenda oko sitowa.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Soma na kamera. Ekhodi kikakingula ekihimbo kighuma; kingira n'enamba nguma neryo byosi bibye hano.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Ghenda. Gabania. Panga. Tuma. Akabalha k'e Uganda k'abandu abawithe ahakughenda n'esente eyitholere erilebibwa.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Erilihira n'e Flutterwave · ni ky'erilengesya erihika hasyabya ekhiyi y'okwenene
strings.plugModal.label.api_key_or_token: Ekhiyi ya API (yikasighalha oko kyuma kikyu)
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Yahangirwe kandi yikalebibwa oko UG. Omulebirya ni w'erilengesya omo kyerekaniro ekí.

Thubwire ekyanga kuwathikya: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buli muyi oko mapu ni nzira eyilhua e Kampala kandi ni sitegi yayo yenyu. Ahali app y'ahandu ekikolha, UG yikayiha olhughendo lhw'erighunzerera, siyikayibugha yithi yiri ahandi.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Esyamapu erilhua e Felt. Emirimu y'obuthuku erilhua e Infrared City. Eby'okwitsemesya erilhua e Tazama. Erilebya n'omulaka erilhua e Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli kyongerwa kiwithe ahakyahikira n'ekhiyi yakyo, bikabikwa oko kyuma kikyu erihika wukingira. Hambania kighuma neryo obupande obukakwamana bukakingulha omo Pool, Lhangira na Hustle Mode. Sihali kikalhua omo UG wuthe wukikingulha.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abakathuhighania bakahirwa omo lusako ky'obwenge. Oyukikirirye erilingirira akasuba oko pool n'oko ripanga.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG ni katale erimbere. Ebyuma by'erihangira bikabana abandu babiribahangira, sibiri lihira eritsuka. Ahakupanga esyamotoka bakabana abapangi ab'okwenene. Ahakusighalha bakabana abandu abakasa oko kiro ekiminyikire. Abaghendesya bakabana emmotoka yusuire embere sibaghende.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Abaghendesya n'esyanamba esyaminyikalire, akapande k'obuwathikya omo lughendo akakagabania ahawuli n'omundu owawusombolha, esyahelmeti oko buli boda, n'erisiti oko buli shilingi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Ikumi ku igana oko pool, omuhendo mughuma oko ripanga, erilihirwa buli lubulhe oko MoMo omo Flutterwave, n'abandu abathawuyithaghire erilangirira.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Ebihimbo ebikakingulha app yaghu n'ahakutsuka n'ahakuhika bihirwemo. Sithukakanganaya omuhendo oghuthuthalhengesirye omo mwanya, kandi enzira yikakanganibwa.
strings.langNote: Emibughe eyithathabya n'omulebirya w'okwenene yikasuba oko Kingerezi ahali ekinywe ekikathabire. Wuthuwathikaye erighunzerera eyaghu.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Emibughe yikahindulhwa na UG neryo yikalebibwa lhwakabiri; erilebibwa n'omukania w'okwenene rikakingulhwa. Ebinywe ebikathabire bikasuba oko Kingerezi.
